subject: math
question: 计算积分 $\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{(x + 1)^2\sqrt{x^2 + 2x + 2}}.$
answer: \begin{array}{r l} I & = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (x + 1)}{(x + 1) ^ {2} \sqrt {(x + 1) ^ {2} + 1}} \overset {x + 1 = \frac {1}{t}} {=} - \int \frac {t \mathrm{d} t}{\sqrt {1 + t ^ {2}}} = - \sqrt {1 + t ^ {2}} + C \\ & = - \frac {\sqrt {x ^ {2} + 2 x + 2}}{x + 1} + C. \end{array}

steps.text: 分析 将根式中的二次三项式配方，再作三角代换；由于分母次数较高，因此也可用倒代换.

方法1

$$
\begin{array}{l} I = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (x + 1)}{(x + 1) ^ {2} \sqrt {(x + 1) ^ {2} + 1}} \stackrel {{x + 1 = \tan t}} {{=}} \int \frac {1}{\tan^ {2} t \sec t} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\cos^ {2} t} \\ = \int \frac {\cos t \mathrm{d} t}{\sin^ {2} t} = - \frac {1}{\sin t} + C = - \frac {\sqrt {x ^ {2} + 2 x + 2}}{x + 1} + C. \end{array}
$$

方法2

$$
\begin{array}{r l} I & = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (x + 1)}{(x + 1) ^ {2} \sqrt {(x + 1) ^ {2} + 1}} \overset {x + 1 = \frac {1}{t}} {=} - \int \frac {t \mathrm{d} t}{\sqrt {1 + t ^ {2}}} = - \sqrt {1 + t ^ {2}} + C \\ & = - \frac {\sqrt {x ^ {2} + 2 x + 2}}{x + 1} + C. \end{array}
$$

solution.final_answer: \begin{array}{r l} I & = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (x + 1)}{(x + 1) ^ {2} \sqrt {(x + 1) ^ {2} + 1}} \overset {x + 1 = \frac {1}{t}} {=} - \int \frac {t \mathrm{d} t}{\sqrt {1 + t ^ {2}}} = - \sqrt {1 + t ^ {2}} + C \\ & = - \frac {\sqrt {x ^ {2} + 2 x + 2}}{x + 1} + C. \end{array}
